notes: Literal count: grep -oE of #hex / rgb(a) / hsl(a) / %23hex finds 124 in app.js, 0 in challenges.js, 0 in daily-core.js. Entries: 124 (1:1, every (line, occurrence) mapped; the build script refuses unmapped or stale keys).

Named colors: none used as a real color. The only named values in these sources are resets (background:none/transparent on .tm-vb.idk/.tm-sharebar/.tm-dot, -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent, color:inherit), so none are entries.
challenges.js and daily-core.js contain no color at all (pure data/logic).

Where the 124 live: 1 JS comment (716); 4 SVG attrs in bookIconSvg (1418-1421); 110 in the ensureTraitsCss() injected <style> string (1963-2111); 2 SVG attrs in the ballot glove (2887); 7 SVG attrs in ballLeverHtml (4444-4456).

Runtime inline color styles: NONE. Every el.style.X / style="..." in app.js is geometry or visibility: .mpb-fill width (1488), .bt-bar i width (2837), .tw-fill width (3818, 6600), .climb-pin/.climb-tag/.climb-you top and .climb-track height (3932-3960), bank meter fill width (1598), --tray-h on <html> (1519), tmRes/tmVotes/tmDone display (2194-2319), .bt-hand left/top/transform/transition (2891-2900), confetti glyph left/top/font-size/--dx/--dy/--rot/animation (3984-3991), Heat Check fill transform and bonus left/width (4152-4254), reel label/strip transform (4303-4328, 5841-5866), lever arm transform (4411-4432), error box display (4742), clipboard textarea offscreen (4750-4752), ticker display (5501), buzz switch cssText (702).

Runtime inline IMAGE styles a theme cannot reach from CSS: (a) #btSheet (.bt-sheet, the tag ballot bottom sheet) gets style.backgroundImage = url(T82PRINT.paper()) at app.js:2625; (b) <html> gets --rr-paper = url(T82PRINT.paper()) at app.js:6256 (consumed by the riso results CSS). T82PRINT.paper is paperDataURL() in results-riso.js: a canvas-drawn cream paper texture (PAPER #F4ECDD + #8b7f68 fibers + #776c5a/#ffffff specks) baked to a data URL. The inline backgroundImage on #btSheet beats any stylesheet background-image unless !important. To theme paper, results-riso.js must read the paper color from getComputedStyle(--t-paper) before drawing. results-riso.js (15 literals) and reel-riso.js (13 literals, canvas fillStyle/strokeStyle incl. #F4ECDD, #8b7f68, #776c5a, rgba(244,236,221,a), ink patterns) are NOT in this key; flag them for whoever owns them.
Canvas: app.js, challenges.js and daily-core.js draw nothing on canvas (no getContext/fillStyle/strokeStyle). All canvas color is in reel-riso.js and results-riso.js.

SVG presentation attributes (13 entries: book icon, glove, basketball/hoop) are NOT reachable by a CSS-file tokenizer, but they have zero specificity, so a plain stylesheet rule like `.mp-book path:nth-child(1){fill:var(--t-accent-ink,#2A1A05)}` or `.bt-hand path{fill:var(--t-paper,#FFFFFF);stroke:var(--t-ink,#232A4E)}` overrides them without !important. Cleaner fix: change the JS strings to fill="var(--t-...,#hex)" (attributes do not resolve var(); use style="fill:var(...)" or classes instead).

The injected <style> (TRAITS_CSS_ID) is appended to <head> at runtime, AFTER styles.css, so its rules win ties. It is ordinary CSS once injected, so the tokenizer can rewrite the JS string literals in place to var(--t-role, #hex) exactly like styles.css. It hard-codes values that already exist as tokens in styles.css: #FFB52E (= --amber, 16 uses) and #E8E4D8 (= --chalk). They should become var(--t-accent)/var(--t-text) too.

Second keycap palette: every gold control in the injected sheet (.tm-vb, .tm-tag, .tm-again, .tp-cta, .tchip, .trait-info-btn) uses #FFC957 -> #F2A81F with a #9a6a12 edge and #1c1608 ink, while button.presti-spin in styles.css uses its own --spin-top/--spin-face/--spin-side/--spin-ink. Both sets are mapped to accent-hi/accent/accent-edge/accent-ink so a theme repaints them together; today they are visibly different golds side by side on the draft pool (pool-row .tchip chips next to presti-spin keycaps).

Cool-grey text family unique to the injected sheet: #8b98a5 (x6), #9fabb7, #7f8b96, #68737e, #c9d2da, #d9d5ce. These are bluer than the site's warm --chalk-dim #9AA0A6. All mapped to text-2 (or text for the two brightest). #68737e is a de-facto text-3 the vocabulary lacks (only used by a dead rule).

Dark surfaces unique to the injected sheet: #1a2129/#141a21 (card gradient), #11171d (legend well), lines #2c343d/#4d5a67/#46515c/#4a5560. They are cooler than the site's warm #1A2027 tunnel / #232B34.

Red keycap (.tm-vb.no, .tchip.anti): #F06A54 top / #D9422D face / #8c2317 edge / #2b0d09 ink. The vocabulary has no bad-hi, so both face stops map to bad and a single-var theme flattens the gradient; proposal: add bad-hi (and good-hi/good-edge per css-a).

DEAD rules (never rendered; safe to delete in the redesign instead of tokenizing, 36 of the 124 literals): .tm-head (hidden forever), .tm-call (hidden forever), .tm-new, .tm-dot/.tm-dot.on, .tm-count, .tm-why, .tm-open (no markup), all of .traits-prompt/.tp-eyebrow/.tp-cta (no markup), .tchip.anti + ::after + pressed states (anti chips filtered out since v50), @keyframes traitInfoPulse (the trait-card-cue class is never added; v50 results ballot has no .tchip). Each dead entry says DEAD in its note.

Pages where these colors show: HOME (renderIntro) = .traits-module card with YES/NO/IDK keycaps, tag chip, share bar, completion keycap. DRAFT, classic mode = .tchip chips on pool player rows (engine 3PT/GRAVITY + community labels), .trait-info-btn and .trait-legend in the pool header; any mode = .mp-book icon on the mode panel's HOW TO PLAY keycap. KAMAN RESULTS = .tchip engine chips on pick cards (renderKamanResults). RESULTS (v50 tag ballot) = .bt-hand glove coach-mark. HEAT CHECK overlay, MID-SEASON CLUTCH overlay and DAILY GATE = basketball/hoop lever art. /bonuses/ page is separate HTML and does not load this injected sheet.
